old_title: Transfer news LIVE: Arsenal close in on Guimaraes, Liverpool get Barcola boost
new_title: Transfer news LIVE: Guimaraes nears Arsenal move, Vinicius Jr latest
old_text:
Arsenal are close to signing Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United after both sides reached an "agreement" over an £80m deal for the midfielder.
After Arsenal's opening bid for the 28-year-old was knocked back, talks between the clubs progressed on Tuesday and Guimaraes is close to getting his move.
The deal represents a key piece of business of Mikel Arteta ahead of Arsenal's title defence - while Newcastle will be left to wave goodbye to another key player following the departures of Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali this summer.
Arsenal's pursuit of Vinicius Jr continues, too, although Real Madrid are said to have offered fresh terms to the Brazilian after his return to training this week.
Manchester United want to sign a left-back, meanwhile, with Lewis Hall reportedly now set on a move to Old Trafford, but Newcastle are determined to stop the exodus and insist he is not for sale.
Liverpool want to sign Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain, meanwhile, and the European champions may have already landed his replacement: Maghnes Akliouche is set to join PSG from Monaco.
Follow all of the latest news, rumours and done deals with our live blog below:
Why Arsenal want Bruno Guimaraes so badly
Arsenal look likely to bring Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes into the club this summer, but what will the Brazilian midfielder bring to Mikel Arteta's side? Archie Corbett takes a look at Bruno's strengths, his suitability for Arsenal's tactical setup, and which of the current Arsenal squad would benefit the most from his arrival.
Vinicius Jr resumes talks with Real Madrid after return to training
Vinicius Jr has revealed that new Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho encouraged him to maintain his "happy" and "joyful" approach to football as the Brazil international navigates ongoing speculation about his future at the Bernabéu.
The 26-year-old forward, who has returned for pre-season training following his World Cup commitments, is entering the final year of his contract next summer and has yet to agree a new deal.
Speaking to Real Madrid TV after his second day back, Vinicius said: "It has gone very well, getting to know the new coach and the new players and training very hard."
He added: "Mourinho wants me to be as I have always been: happy, joyful and to play my football. We have to prepare physically so that during the season, we have fewer injuries and thus be able to count on everyone."
Liverpool get Bradley Barcola boost?
Liverpool remain interested in signing Bradley Barcola this summer as the Reds bid to talk Paris Saint-Germain down from their £140m asking price.
But Liverpool could have received a boost by the news that PSG are set to sign Monaco's France international winger Maghnes Akliouche in a £42.8m deal.
Could PSG already be lining up Barcola's replacement in the 24-year-old Akliouche?
Mykhailo Mudryk on the move?
Mykhailo Mudryk looks in line to feature for Chelsea in a friendly against Juventus on Wednesday, though the Ukrainian is a transfer target for several clubs after being cleared to play again following the resolution of his doping ban. Coventry City are reported by the Mirror to be among those interested - Frank Lampard worked briefly with Mudryk during his second spell at Stamford Bridge.
Fenerbahce emerge as surprise suitor for Marcus Rashford
The Sun suggests that Fenerbahce are ready to make a sizeable offer to Marcus Rashford as the England international again seeks a route out of Manchester United after a productive loan spell at Barcelona last season.
Tijjani Reijnders to Nottingham Forest?
This would be a surprise move. Nottingham Forest have been linked with Manchester City midfielder Tijjani Reijnders.
Forest have shown an interest in the Netherlands international, according to the Daily Mail, as they look to replace Elliot Anderson - who went the other way and joined Man City this summer.
The former Milan midfielder is valued at around £55m, while Forest have also been linked with Tottenham's Lucas Bergvall.
Liverpool have no plans to sell Cody Gakpo after Tottenham links
Liverpool have no plans to sell Cody Gakpo, despite Tottenham expressing their interest in the 27-year-old Netherlands forward.
Gakpo has four years left on his deal and Liverpool would not sanction a move without a direct replacement - although they have been linked with Bradley Barcola this summer, and the PSG star will not come cheap.
Spurs have also been linked with Manchester City forward Savinho, with Roberto De Zerbi keen to improve Tottenham's attacking options.
Bruno Guimaraes departure could leave Newcastle in freefall
As captain, Bruno Guimaraes lifted the Carabao Cup at Wembley in March last year - the Magpies' first major domestic trophy in 70 years - having established himself as a talisman for fans who dared to believe once again.
But Alexander Isak's controversial departure for Liverpool last season sparked something of a decline, and Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali and Howe himself have since departed this summer to leave the club in a state of flux.
Guimaraes' departure would blow another sizeable hole in the squad and leave the new head coach - German Matthias Jaissle has been with the players since the weekend, but is yet to be formally announced - with a major task to mould together a new-look side before the season's opener against Liverpool on August 23.
Richard Jolly has more:
Trabzonspor confirm Salah talks
Question marks over Mohamed Salah's next club could be about to disappear after Turkish side Trabzonspor confirmed that talks over a deal with the Egyptian had begun.
The winger has not landed on a new team since ending his glory-laden spell with Liverpool at the end of last season.
"Negotiations have begun regarding the transfer of professional footballer Mohamed Salah to our club," Trabzonspor posted on X.
Arsenal close in on Guimaraes with 'agreement' reached
Here's more on today's top story: Arsenal's move for Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes is finally nearing completion.
The Gunners are confident of finally singing the 28-year-old midfielder, whose future has been the subject of frenzied speculation for weeks ever since it emerged that he had indicated that he wanted to leave Tyneside for the Emirates Stadium.
Guimaraes reported for duty at Newcastle's pre-season training camp in La Manga in Spain on Monday, just hours after Newcastle rejected an opening bid from Arsenal.
It now appears that significant progress has been made with the Premier League champions closing in on a deal which would see them finally capture a man they have long coveted.
Newcastle have known for months that they might have to make a decision over a player they did not want to sell, while holding a valuation - understood to be in the region of £80m - at which business might have to be done.
new_text:
Bruno Guimaraes has received permission to travel to Arsenal and complete his £75m move from Newcastle United. The 28-year-old midfielder will undergo a medical at the Premier League champions within the coming days after both clubs agreed a fee with an announcement of his signing expected shortly afterwards.
The deal represents a key piece of business of Mikel Arteta ahead of Arsenal's title defence - while Newcastle will be left to wave goodbye to another key player following the departures of Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali this summer.
Arsenal will now turn to continuing their pursuit of Guimaraes' international team-mate Vinicius Jr, although the Gunners believe it is increasingly likely that he stays at Real Madrid, who have significantly upped their new contract offer to the Brazilian star.
Liverpool, meanwhile, want to sign Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain and have also lined up his teammate Ibrahim Mbaye in what could be a double swoop for Andoni Iraola's side. The European champions may be willing to let them go with Maghnes Akliouche is set to join from Monaco.
Elsewhere, Manchester United want to sign a left-back with Lewis Hall reportedly now set on a move to Old Trafford, but Newcastle are determined to stop the exodus and insist he is not for sale.
Follow all of the latest news, rumours and done deals with our live blog below:
Arsenal close in on Guimaraes with £75m fee agreed
Arsenal's move for Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes is finally nearing completion.
The Gunners are confident of finally singing the 28-year-old midfielder, whose future has been the subject of frenzied speculation for weeks ever since it emerged that he had indicated that he wanted to leave Tyneside for the Emirates Stadium.
Guimaraes reported for duty at Newcastle's pre-season training camp in La Manga in Spain on Monday, just hours after Newcastle rejected an opening bid from Arsenal.
It now appears that significant progress has been made with the Premier League champions closing in on a cut-price £75m deal which would see them finally capture a man they have long coveted.
Good morning!
Welcome to The Independent's coverage of today's latest transfer news and gossip.
Newcastle officially have a new manager who will be keen to stop the exodus of players this summer while Arsenal continue to make shrewd signings as they aim to defend their Premier League title.
Liverpool are in the market for two PSG players and Man Utd are attempting to bring in defensive cover at left-back.
Let's get stuck into it...
The real reason Chelsea signed Jordan Henderson
Jordan Henderson's move to Chelsea represents one of the more peculiar transfers of the summer. But dig a little deeper and the logic becomes at least more convincing. A player in the twilight of a glittering career is returning to one of the biggest clubs in Europe. Awkward spells with Al-Ettifaq and Ajax were followed by a more productive and defined role in an excellent Brentford season last term.
Man United Women appoint Eva Olid as new head coach after Marc Skinner exit
Manchester United Women have announced the appointment of Eva Olid as their new head coach on an initial two-year deal with the option of a further year.
Vinicius Jr reveals what Jose Mourinho told him as he weighs up his future amid Arsenal links
Vinicius Jr has revealed that new Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho encouraged him to maintain his "happy" and "joyful" approach to football as the Brazil international navigates ongoing speculation about his future at the Bernabéu.
Why is Mohamed Salah signing for Trabzonspor?
The Liverpool icon, who left Anfield as a free agent at the end of last season, has arrived in Turkey ahead of the move and has been pictured by the club wearing the team's colours ahead of signing his contract on Thursday. He will wear the number 61 shirt at his new club.
Real Madrid legend implores 'deceitful' Gianni Infantino to resign as Fifa president
Luis Figo has implored Gianni Infantino to resign as pressure mounts on the much-criticised Fifa president following his foiled attempts to sell stakes in the World Cup.
Infantino was forced to abandon his plans - namely to sell stakes in the World Cup and other Fifa tournaments to private investors - after public uproar last week, with Uefa confirming a boycott of Fifa events if the plan was voted through.
Man United set to offload two goalkeepers as Michael Carrick's squad overhaul gathers pace
Manchester United are poised to offload two goalkeepers, with Radek Vitek set to join Middlesbrough in a deal potentially worth up to £14 million, while Altay Bayindir prepares for a loan move to Celta Vigo.
Vitek, a 22-year-old Czech shot-stopper, is nearing a permanent switch to last season's Championship play-off finalists Middlesbrough following an impressive loan spell at Bristol City.
Kang-In reacts to Atletico move
South Korea winger Lee Kang-In spoke about joining Atletico Madrid
The 25-year-old signed a five-year contract with the LaLiga side who paid around €40m to PSG.
He said "I'm very pleased and very happy to join this great club, with a lot of desire for everything, to meet my team-mates, to know the club, to know the coach, to meet the entire coaching staff and then to meet fans who have told me that they are the best in the world."
Juventus pursuing Zirkzee
Juventus are said to be interested in Manchester United's Joshua Zirkzee and hope to bring the forward in on a loan deal.
Zirkzee is down the pecking order under Michael Carrick and could be keen on the move though the right deal will need to be struck for all parties.
Juve have already signed Randal Kolo Muani and Kerim Alajbegovic so there is no urgency on their part to get Zirkee's move done.
